heidegger_usage: Bringing a matter to sight (ἀποφαίνεσθαι); the fundamental determination of human being-there; bearer and mastery of interpretedness; every λόγος is σύνθεσις or διαίρεσις; achieves independence as ἀποφαίνεσθαι when separated from πρᾶξις; a basic phenomenon of κοινωνία.
notes: Most pervasive term in the course. Standard 'reason' systematically rejected; existential-ontological rendering as 'speech' or 'discourse' that discloses beings.

heidegger_usage: Being-there in existential rendering; the being of a being; five being-characters from Met. Δ8 (τὸ τί ἦν εἶναι, τὸ καθόλου, τὸ γένος, τὸ ὑποκείμενον, and a fifth connected to πέρας); λόγος οὐσίας = definition that discloses the being of beings.
notes: Heidegger renders as 'being-there' or 'beingness' rather than traditional 'substance.' Central to the course's destructive retrieval of Greek ontology.

heidegger_usage: The ontologically basic determination of living; ψυχή as πρακτικὴ ἐνέργεια; psychology has nothing to do with consciousness but is the doctrine of the being of living things; ψυχή as the being-taken of beings as living things; πάθη as λόγοι ἔνυλοι of ψυχή.
notes: De-psychologized: not 'consciousness' or 'mind' but ontological determination of living.

heidegger_usage: Four general meanings from Met. Δ21: (1) quality admitting alteration, (2) ἐνέργειαι/ἀλλοιώσεις already underway, (3) harmful alterations especially involving λύπη, (4) great magnitudes of misfortune. As πίστις in rhetoric; three γινόμενα in ψυχή (πάθη, δυνάμεις, ἕξεις); the ground out of which speaking arises.
notes: Not 'passion' or 'emotion' but disposition, being-affected, the manner of finding-oneself in the world.

heidegger_usage: The determination of the genuineness of being-there in a moment of being-composed as to something; four senses of ἔχειν from Met. Δ23; ἕξις = ἐνέργεια of the having (Met. Δ20); ἕξις as μεταξύ; ἀρετή = ἕξις προαιρετική ἐν μεσότητι; conceptuality as ἕξις πρὸς ἄλλον.
notes: Not 'habit' but 'being-composed,' 'having-in-itself,' the how of being-there's disposition.

heidegger_usage: Not spatial boundary but the limit that constitutes the genuine there of a being; connected to τέλος as ἔσχατον; a being-aspect in beings; πέρας is its site, its place, its being-produced, being-in-its-place; site (τόπος) as positive ontological determination.
notes: Standard in early occurrences; reinterpreted as existential-ontological from FP2b onward.

heidegger_usage: Competence -- having one's being-possibility at one's disposal; not 'virtue' in moralizing sense; ἕξις προαιρετική ἐν μεσότητι; determined by temporality through ἔθος; the being of ἀρετή = μεσότης, simultaneously ἀκρότης with regard to the εὖ.
notes: 'Excellence' preferred over 'virtue'; existential rendering as mode of being-there.

heidegger_usage: Concern; the mode of being proper to human beings; πρακτική τοῦ λόγον ἔχοντος; distinguished from ποίησις.
notes: Reinterpreted as 'concern' rather than 'action.' Distinguished from ποίησις throughout.

heidegger_usage: Being-at-work; being-grasped-in-becoming-completed; stretches itself out toward ἐντελέχεια; κίνησις is a mode of ἐνέργεια.
notes: Not 'actuality' but being-at-work/becoming-completed. Distinct from ἐντελέχεια.

heidegger_usage: Three registers: methodological (τρόπος τῆς δυνάμεως); psychic (co-given possibilities); ontological (meaningfulness, Bedeutsamkeit, NOT modal possibility).
notes: Not 'possibility' but capacity/meaningfulness/availability-for. Ontological rendering emerges fully in Second Part.

heidegger_usage: Having-a-view; the basic phenomenon of everydayness; genuine discoveredness of being-with-one-another; reaches πάντα; distinguished from ἐπιστήμη, φαντασία, and προαίρεσις.
notes: Standard 'opinion' supplemented with existential 'having-a-view.'

heidegger_usage: Making-present-to-itself; ground of νοεῖν; not 'imagination' in the modern sense; bodily being-in-the-world; distinguished from αἴσθησις.
notes: Not 'imagination' but making-present-to-itself. Ground of νοεῖν.

heidegger_usage: Being-with-one-another; community; fulfilled in δόξα; the social context of λόγος.
notes: Standard with existential inflection.

heidegger_usage: Being-resolved; resolve; acting from out of oneself; distinguished from δόξα in seven respects.
notes: Not 'choice' but 'being-resolved' or 'resolving-oneself.'

heidegger_usage: Looking-around; practical insight; first aspect of ἦθος-cultivation; mode of sight in being-in-care.
notes: Not 'practical wisdom' but 'looking-around' or 'circumspection.'

heidegger_usage: The moment; the decisive moment; the entirety of circumstances; the mean = καιρός; ἀγαθόν is always κατὰ τὸν καιρόν.
notes: Standard with existential emphasis.

heidegger_usage: Maintaining-itself-in-its-being-completed; enteles + echein = possession of completion; the fundamental concept of Aristotelian ontology; what excludes every δύναμις.
notes: Not 'actuality' but 'being-completed,' 'maintaining-itself-at-the-end.' Distinguished from ἐνέργεια.

heidegger_usage: Privation as constitutive of being; negation is a position; 'I miss him very much' = a determinate way of his being-there for me.
notes: Not mere lack but positive ontological determination. Constitutive of the dichos structure enabling κίνησις.

heidegger_usage: Basic condition of the possibility of being-in-the-world; goes toward τὰ πάντα; the 'so-called' νοῦς = διανοεῖσθαι; ἀπαθές, δεκτικὸν τοῦ εἴδους.
notes: Not 'intellect' but the fundamental openness of being-in-the-world.

heidegger_usage: Fundamental determinations of being-in-the-world; co-given with all πάθη; ground of δίωξις and φυγή; ζωή identified with ἡδονή.
notes: Standard (pleasure/pain) with existential deepening.

heidegger_usage: Limitation; λόγος οὐσίας; not scholastic definition but circumscription of being; further determined as γνωρισμός.
notes: Not scholastic definition but existential limitation/circumscription.

heidegger_usage: A being-determination; τέλος of πρᾶξις; no universal good (ἀγαθόν καθόλου); always κατὰ τὸν καιρόν; arrived at via exclusion (ψυχῆς ἐνέργεια κατ' ἀρετήν).
notes: No universal good; ἀγαθόν is always πέρας of πρᾶξις, always κατὰ τὸν καιρόν.

heidegger_usage: End as limit (πέρας); being-an-end; not aim/purpose; τέλειον from Met. Δ16; τελευτή as being-gone-from-being-there.
notes: Not aim or purpose but mode of being itself.

heidegger_usage: Conviction, trust; threefold: λόγος/ἦθος/πάθος; modes of address that generate conviction.
notes: Standard translation retained.

heidegger_usage: Comportment of the speaker; character as πίστις; ἔθος as habituation; requires ἐμπειρία and χρόνος.
notes: Standard 'character' partially deepened with existential nuance.

heidegger_usage: Life as mode of being; being-in-a-world; not biological life; ζῷον λόγον ἔχον presupposes ζωή as ontological determination.
notes: Not biological life but ontological determination of living.

heidegger_usage: Bringing-to-sight; genuine function of λόγος; making manifest what is being spoken about.
notes: Reinterpreted from 'assertion' to 'bringing-to-sight.'

heidegger_usage: Modes of addressing beings; from ἀγορεύειν (marketplace speech); not logical categories but ways of speaking to beings in public discourse.
notes: Etymological retrieval: from ἀγορεύειν (marketplace speech), not abstract logical categories.

heidegger_usage: Truth-disclosing; ἕξις of being-unconcealed; not correspondence but unconcealment; disclosive mode of being-in-the-world.
notes: Not correspondence-truth but unconcealment, being-uncovered.

heidegger_usage: The mean πρὸς ἡμᾶς; simultaneously ἀκρότης with regard to εὖ; not quantitative midpoint but way of being-composed; oriented toward καιρός.
notes: The mean is the extreme: μεσότης = ἀκρότης when understood ontologically.

heidegger_usage: Fear/being-afraid; πάθος disclosing futural character of being-there; no parallel between the frightening and being-afraid; condition of the possibility of ἀνδρεία.
notes: Standard 'fear' retained but deepened as disclosive πάθος revealing futural character.

heidegger_usage: Making, production; ends in ἔργον; Greek ontology derives from ποίησις not from nature.
notes: Standard translation. Key genealogical claim: Greek ontology derives from ποίησις/πρᾶξις, not from nature.

heidegger_usage: The always-already-being-there; ἀρχὴ κινήσεως; not modern 'nature' but beings as self-moving.
notes: Not modern 'nature' but beings characterized by self-movement.

heidegger_usage: From-out-of-which; principle; not rationalist 'first principles'; Physics as ἀρχή-research.
notes: Physics reframed as ἀρχή-research, not empirical science.

heidegger_usage: Movement; being-moved; ἐντελέχεια τοῦ δυνάμει ὄντος; the being of beings of the world; not alongside beings but the being of beings; ἀτελὴς ἐνέργεια.
notes: Central concept of the Second Part. Not locomotion but the being-character of movable beings.

heidegger_usage: Knowing; being securely situated toward the matter; directed toward ἀεί; distinguished from δόξα.
notes: Standard 'knowledge' retained but deepened as existential comportment.

heidegger_usage: One who examines nature; prioritizes εἶδος over ὕλη; the real φυσικός addresses beings in terms of εἶδος.
notes: Standard translation retained.

heidegger_usage: ἁπλῶς τέλειον of being-there; not 'happiness' in hedonistic sense; the most complete end of human being-there.
notes: Not 'happiness' but the ἁπλῶς τέλειον, the most complete end.

heidegger_usage: The serious one; mode of being where everything rides on it; one who has taken being-possibility seriously.
notes: Reinterpreted as existential mode of taking one's being seriously.

heidegger_usage: Change; broader than κίνησις; encompasses γένεσις and φθορά.
notes: Standard translation. Broader genus of which κίνησις is a species.

heidegger_usage: Inability-to-get-through; positive function of exhibiting knots; disclosing the matter through blockage.
notes: Not mere difficulty but positive methodological function.

heidegger_usage: The three fore-structures constituting the interpretedness of being-there; hermeneutic pre-structure.
notes: German terms, not Greek. Heidegger's own hermeneutic vocabulary.

heidegger_usage: Idle chatter; the expressed increasingly loses its ground; dominant mode of λόγος in everydayness.
notes: German term, not Greek. Anticipates Being and Time analysis.

heidegger_usage: Courage; ἕξις of being-afraid in the right manner; fear is the condition of the possibility of courage.
notes: Standard translation. Courage requires fear as its condition of possibility.

heidegger_usage: Preservation / disappearing-out-of-being-there; extreme modes of ἕξις.
notes: Standard translation retained.

heidegger_usage: Making-known; making-familiar with a being in its being; synonym for ὁρισμός.
notes: Further determination of ὁρισμός.

heidegger_usage: Dialectic; limited δύναμις compared to philosophy; same subject matter but different τρόπος τῆς δυνάμεως.
notes: Standard translation. Contrasted with φιλοσοφία.

heidegger_usage: Sophistic; appears to be philosophy but is not (φαινομένη οὖσα δ' οὔ).
notes: Standard translation. Contrasted with φιλοσοφία.

heidegger_usage: Pre-given; from-which of discourse; emerges from ἔνδοξον.
notes: Standard translation with etymological gloss.

heidegger_usage: Project; about-which of discourse; the ἔνδοξον raised for debate.
notes: Standard translation.

heidegger_usage: Self-deprecator / boaster; deficient modes of ἀληθεύειν; Socrates as εἴρων.
notes: Standard translation. Deficient modes contrasted with ἀληθεύειν.

heidegger_usage: Believing; dispositional ground of fear; the believing-oneself-to-be-affected.
notes: Deepened as dispositional ground of φόβος.

heidegger_usage: Hope of being saved; co-constitutive of fear; one can only fear when there remains hope.
notes: Standard translation. Co-constitutive with φόβος.

heidegger_usage: Proximity; converts threat into danger; what is far off is not yet φοβερόν.
notes: Standard translation. Key encounter-character of the φοβερόν.

heidegger_usage: Site, place; positive ontological determination; connected to πέρας.
notes: Not mere spatial location but positive ontological determination.

heidegger_usage: Presence; of what is always already there; being-there of beings.
notes: Standard 'presence' deepened as ontological determination.

heidegger_usage: World-order; characterized by παρουσία and πέρας; the totality of what is always already there.
notes: Standard translation.

heidegger_usage: The limitless; positive determination of the continuous; not negative privation but positive character of extensional being.
notes: Not negative privation but positive determination of the continuous.

heidegger_usage: That which becomes visible in assertion; not 'substance' in scholastic sense; what lies before as already addressed.
notes: Not scholastic 'substance' but what becomes visible in addressing.

heidegger_usage: Pure consideration; highest possibility of existence; pure tarrying alongside beings.
notes: Not 'pastime' but pure contemplative tarrying -- highest mode of existence.

heidegger_usage: Being-in-relation-to-another; = being-in-the-world; fundamental character of being-in-the-world; every being in movement is πρός ἄλληλα.
notes: Not Aristotelian 'category of relation' but fundamental ontological character of being-in-the-world.

heidegger_usage: The making / the undergoing; enter the genuine definition of κίνησις: ἐνέργεια τοῦ δυνάμει ποιητικοῦ καὶ παθητικοῦ.
notes: Standard translation. Enter the genuine (second) definition of κίνησις.

heidegger_usage: Incomplete; κίνησις = ἀτελὴς ἐνέργεια; movement is intrinsically incomplete being-at-work.
notes: Standard translation. Defines κίνησις as incomplete ἐνέργεια.

heidegger_usage: Indeterminate; movement is genuinely ἀόριστον; resists determinacy as its essential character.
notes: Not merely 'indefinite' but essentially indeterminate as an ontological character.

heidegger_usage: Accounts-in-matter; πάθη as inseparable from ὕλη; the φυσικός addresses πάθη as λόγοι ἔνυλοι.
notes: Standard scholarly translation. Key to the εἶδος/ὕλη distinction in De Anima A 1.

heidegger_usage: Being-there; the fundamental term for human existence; anticipates BT usage; replaces ψυχή/consciousness vocabulary.
notes: German term, not Greek. Heidegger's own existential-analytic vocabulary, pervasive from FP2a onward.

heidegger_usage: Interpretedness; the always-already-interpreted condition of being-there; constituted by Vorhabe/Vorsicht/Vorgriff.
notes: German term, not Greek. Key concept linking hermeneutic pre-structure to κίνησις analysis.
